bounded_operation: An unloaded supported original full-size eye fixture is coupled into a fixed unpowered original pintle interface: lift lock handle/open upper latch, lower compatible eye over horn, close latch, verify flush positive lock and released retention. This is not moving a vehicle or a roadworthiness check.
undocumented: Every internal lock dog, spring, force, clearance, hinge coordinate and replica contour must be labeled BENCHMARK_AUTHORED. The external flush-handle/positive-latch topology is documented, hidden OEM cam dimensions are not.

occupation.core_duty: Couple or uncouple trailers by changing trailer jack positions, connecting or disconnecting air or electrical lines, or manipulating fifth-wheel locks.
occupation.scope_limit: Pintle-equipped subset; no claim every truck driver uses this model or a measured per-worker frequency.

comparators.1886: Threaded shackle pin through lug, not hinged horn closure/flush secondary dog. This rules out another shackle candidate.
comparators.1090: Final rejection for small sliding fake railway knuckle, not full-size hook+eye. Do not repeat miniaturization or invented sliding mechanism.
comparators.1676: Final trailer lift/rolling rover+ball cup; no modeled latch. This candidate must preserve full-size interface and secondary lock.

findings: Exact density integration gives a2.0526kg free eye plus stem, above a comfortable capability margin. Do not silently reduce density or scale the documented minimum31.75mm wire diameter.

Manual free-eye movement omits the attached trailer tongue/jack constraints. The manufacturer says position/lower the drawbar eye; it does not establish that a free2kg bench eye replicates vehicle coupling.
